name: Event Envelope Model
description: Application event contract and envelope used for persistence and transport.

description: Publishing a strongly typed event to the durable Outbox.

description: Loading pending Outbox messages, handling publishing retries, and recording the result.

description: Scheduled cleanup of expired Outbox messages using application-defined expiration rules.

description: Receiving an HTTP envelope and storing it in the durable Inbox.

description: Loading received Inbox messages and dispatching them to typed handlers.
